description.value: Ki Tea House Cafe is a Taiwanese and Japanese-style tea house in Burnaby's Royal Oak neighbourhood, specializing in bubble tea and Asian cuisine. The cafe offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a casual stop for cyclists passing through the area.

address.value: 6888 Royal Oak Avenue, Unit 105, Burnaby, BC V5J4J2

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 79m; rack (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 2 spaces.
